text: Mehwish Butt, a senior manager at Zenith Pharma (Pvt) Ltd with a declared monthly income of PKR 600,000, exhibited suspicious cash deposit activity between August 3 and August 25, 2026. The account received ten separate cash deposits totaling PKR 5,572,400, all conducted at the Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch in Karachi. Several of these transactions were structured to remain just below the Cash Transaction Report (CTR) threshold of PKR 300,000, including deposits of PKR 279,000 on August 3, PKR 270,000 on August 20, and PKR 299,000 on August 25. Additionally, two large cash deposits of PKR 1,694,000 each were recorded on August 15 and August 22, significantly exceeding the customer’s declared monthly income. This pattern of repeated cash deposits, combined with the use of amounts slightly below reporting thresholds and the volume of cash inconsistent with the customer’s salaried occupation, strongly suggests an attempt to evade regulatory reporting requirements. The activity is indicative of structuring or layering, potentially related to money laundering or tax evasion. No legitimate business reason for such high-volume cash handling has been identified for a salaried individual. The account has been placed under enhanced monitoring, and this report is filed to alert the Financial Intelligence Unit to the suspicious nature of these transactions.
